verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms the trade-mark search host serves a real robots.txt (HTTP 200), and that file tells keyless agents they are walled off before they fetch anything else, so an agent can learn its access rules up front. Coverage is only partial: just one IPO host was probed, and the file's directives are characterised rather than quoted. missing for 10: verbatim robots.txt directives, evidence of robots.txt on the gov.uk guidance surface and other IPO hosts, first-party documentation of the crawl policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything

citations.quote: the search application host walls keyless agents at robots.txt itself
